text: Scope: identical finite Double bits produce identical decimal CSV cells, not blanket byte equality for numerically close workflows or caller-owned JSON/text. Contrast (including temporal delegation) and template-training cells share first HALF_EVEN rounded precision 1..17 that round-trips, strip decimal zeros, BigDecimal canonical exponent spelling, preserve signed zero. Existing deterministic AOI 12-decimal proportions and hex evidence stay compatible. The original sigma regression failed on JVM (1.0 versus 1). A first implementation exposed Scala.js BigDecimal(Double) corrupting -1e23; exact integer construction from IEEE bits avoids that conversion. Independent Python decimal sweep predicts SHA-256 af7055f3005ce812e93e638b7f8c2e9129c16163898c5e1514de8bec708027f7 for 16376 signed/exponent/mantissa cells; tests pin this on both runtimes.
